import ROOT
print(ROOT.gROOT.GetVersion())
for path in ['/data/GamGam/MC/ttH_preselection.root','/data/GamGam/data/data_preselection.root']:
 f=ROOT.TFile.Open(path)
 print('\n',path, bool(f), [x.GetName() for x in f.GetListOfKeys()])
 for k in f.GetListOfKeys():
  o=k.ReadObj()
  if o.InheritsFrom('TTree'):
   print(o.GetName(),o.GetEntries(),[(b.GetName(),b.GetClassName(),b.GetTitle()) for b in o.GetListOfBranches()])
